architecture.code: direct sum of local [3,1,3] repetition-coset blocks

system.base_dynamics: identity transport; all movement is attributed explicitly to the tested bridge or control

claim: Sparse distributed parity over function-relevant local relations enables identity-preserving organizational-regime and functional recovery within a predefined one-error-per-block radius, without continuous-state memory.
functional_target: four frozen low-frequency projection responses defined in FUNCTIONAL_TARGET.md
invalidation_conditions: parity or decoder input contains continuous pre-state values or magnitudes
functional probe values enter encoding, parity construction, decoding, correction, or selection
a local decoder accesses more than one block
a global decoder silently replaces the local decoder
stored parity uniquely identifies the continuous pre-state
final seeds are consumed after a failed validation gate
architecture or radius changes after validation
non_claims: not cross-scale, compositional, universal, continuum, or physical emergence
parameter_selection: Calibration-only median functional recovery plus identity minus 0.01 corrective cost; ties prefer lower eta then lower margin.
relational_alphabet: 48 local horizontal, vertical, and diagonal order bits defined in RELATIONAL_ALPHABET.md
stopping_condition: If validation fails any mandatory gate, emit VALIDATION_GATE_FAILED, do not access final seeds, and require a new experiment identifier for any change.

threshold_derivation.superiority_margin_min: max(0.05, half calibration target-minus-best-control recovery-rate margin)

gate_requirements: target exceeds frozen RT-02 functional recovery
target exceeds random parity and random memory
